Projects.description: Not tutorial projects — each one runs in a real production environment or was built for a real client.

crazy_lister.name: Crazy Lister v3.5
crazy_lister.description: A full automation system that reduced data entry time by 100% and controlled over 362,000 EGP in sales. Completely eliminates manual workload via SP-API.

apex.name: Apex — 60sec.shop
apex.description: A full Monorepo built to S1-S15 enterprise security protocols. Contains 4 apps (API, Merchant Admin, Super Admin, Store), with complete tenant isolation, immutable audit logs, and Island Architecture.

commander_os.name: Commander OS
commander_os.description: Comprehensive enterprise resource planning (ERP) system tracking Sales, Employees, Attendance, Customers, Purchasing, Suppliers, and Inventory. Tracks real production numbers (collections reaching 544,560 EGP).

cerebras_studio.name: Cerebras Dev Studio
cerebras_studio.description: A custom IDE operating as an ultra-fast AI coding assistant. Manages a pool of encrypted API keys with automatic rotation and sliding window rate limiting. Supports 3 permission modes and full VS Code integration.

darb_almaha.name: DarbAlmaha — Qatar
darb_almaha.description: Professional landing page with full SEO standards for a Qatar-based cleaning company. Powered by 4 advertising platforms (Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, GA4), with 5-type Schema.org structured data and advanced CSP security.

ai_proxy.name: AI Key Proxy
ai_proxy.description: A FastAPI server acting as an encrypted proxy for Cerebras AI. Manages an AES-256 encrypted key pool with sliding window rate control and 3 automatic retry attempts on failure.

video_downloader.name: Queue Downloader
video_downloader.tagline: Smart Download Tool with Queue Management
video_downloader.description: A Python desktop application for downloading segmented video files (SharePoint, OneDrive) with full queue control. Uses 10 concurrent fragments with infinite retry and automatic post-download actions.

alyusr.name: Al Yusr System
alyusr.description: A complete enterprise management system for Al Yusr Pastirma Factory. Built with React + TypeScript (94% TypeScript coverage) and Vite, covering inventory management, production tracking, and financial accounting.

kitvet.name: Kitvet
kitvet.description: A high-conversion professional landing page displaying the Kitvet.com domain for sale. Features a modern design (High-authority asset for sale) and rapid integration with direct broker chat.

mounir_data_gen.name: Mounir Data Gen
mounir_data_gen.description: An advanced engineering tool for automated data generation, designed to automate testing scenarios and prepare massive data sets (Mock/Seeding) for comprehensive testing environments.
